title: Estrus ID Scoring API
intro: A Flask API for livestock image processing with model inference and scoring.
summary: Edge-to-cloud Flask API orchestrating YOLOv8 scoring, feeding Jetson edge pipelines and cloud analytics with CI/CD on Google Cloud Run.
features: REST endpoints for uploads and processing
Dockerized builds and CI/CD to Cloud Run
Workflows for training/testing integration and accuracy tracking

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A REST API to process livestock data and compute model-based estrus scoring using YOLOv8 detections.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Automate estrus detection and scoring for downstream analytics and experiments.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Built the API, trained/integrated YOLOv8 models, designed scoring logic, and configured CI/CD to Cloud Run.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Enabled structured evaluation, improving detection accuracy metrics by >20% across production pilots.
